title: Cut-offs — GPT100 Miler official page
publisher: SingleTrack Events / Grampians Peaks Trail 100 Miler
claims: The Miler's total limit is 50 hours: start at Mt Zero Picnic Area 8:00 AM Friday 6 November 2026, GAR Trailhead 12:00 PM, Mt Difficult 5:00 PM, Halls Gap 8:00 PM, Rosea Carpark 11:00 PM, Borough Huts Camp 2:15 AM Saturday 7 November, Mt William Carpark 8:15 AM, Jimmy Creek Campground 2:30 PM, Yarram Gap Rd 6:30 PM, Griffin Fireline 10:15 PM, Cassidys Gap Rd 2:00 AM Sunday 8 November, Bainggug Carpark 6:30 AM, and finish Dunkeld 10:00 AM.

The supporting races have their own limits: GPT50K / Stage 1 13 hours from 6:00 AM Thursday 5 November to 7:00 PM at Halls Gap; Stage 2 12 hours from 5:50 AM Friday to 6:00 PM at Mt William Carpark; Stage 3 12 hours from 6:00 AM Saturday to 6:00 PM at Griffin Fireline; GPT33 10 hours and Stage 4 10.5 hours on Sunday from Griffin Fireline to Dunkeld at 5:00 PM; GPT14K 3.5 hours; GPT6K 2 hours 45 minutes.
